apps.name: HelderWeer
apps.description: Material You weer-app met verwachtingen, waarschuwingen, radar en weerdetails.
apps.changelog: HelderWeer v2.1.2 🌦️ HelderWeer is now available in both English and Dutch. The app automatically follows your device language: - 🇳🇱 Dutch system language → Dutch - 🌍 Any other system language → English What's new 🌍 English & Dutch support - Added a fully localized English interface. - Home, map, warnings, weather details and settings now adapt automatically to your device language. - Widgets and local notifications are localized as well. - Weather conditions, wind directions, air quality information and moon phases are translated automatically. - Dates and units are displayed according to the active language. - Location search now requests Dutch or English place names depending on the app language. 🔧 Improvements carried over from v2.1.1 - Fixed widget temperature rounding so widgets now match the temperature shown inside the app. - Hourly temperatures in the daily widget use the same correct rounding. - Improved background task handling to prevent duplicate immediate weather checks. Highlights HelderWeer also includes: - 🌧️ Live precipitation radar and weather maps - ⚠️ Official severe weather warnings - ☔ Optional upcoming rain notifications - 📊 Multiple forecast models including KNMI HARMONIE, ECMWF, ICON, Météo-France, MET Norway, UK Met Office and GFS - 🎯 Automatic selection of an appropriate weather model - 🌬️ Wind, humidity, pressure, dew point and visibility information - 🌿 Air quality and pollen forecasts - 🌊 Coastal weather where available - ☀️ Sun, moon and UV information - 📍 Favorite locations and location search - 📱 Three Material You widget formats - 🎨 Material, Soft and Glass widget styles - 🔋 Battery-friendly background updates with no continuous background GPS
